Citation.description: A reference to the source data or its documentation. At least one of doi, url or text is required.

doi.description: Bare DOI, without the doi: prefix or resolver URL, e.g. 10.1234/abcd.

text.description: Free-text citation, for sources without a DOI or URL.

url.description: Web address of the source or its documentation.

used_for_linkage.description: True if this is the source actually used for the linkage. Replaces the old "*" marker.

collection_countries.description: Countries in which participant data were collected, as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes.

domain_other.description: Free-text domain. Required when domain = OTHER.

is_categorical.description: True if the variable takes categorical rather than numeric values.

name.description: Descriptive term for the variable, e.g. NO2, PM2.5, Lden, NDVI.

ontology_terms.description: Resolvable identifiers for the exposure. Chemicals: INCHIKEY (preferred), PUBCHEM, DTXSID, CAS. Physical or environmental exposures: ExO, ENVO, MESH. Leave empty if no term exists.

regions.description: ISO 3166-1 / ISO 3166-2 codes. Required when scope = COUNTRIES_OR_REGIONS.

Linkage.description: How exposure values were assigned to participants.

aggregation.description: Summary statistic applied to the exposure values. Buffer geometry is recorded once, under operation.

aggregation_n.description: N for MULTI_YEAR_MEAN (years) or PERCENTILE (the percentile).

buffer_radii_m.description: Buffer radii in metres. Required for CIRCULAR_BUFFER; list all radii if several were reported.

centroid_areal_unit.description: The areal unit the centroid represents, e.g. "output area".

centroid_weighting.description: How the centroid was computed. Required for any *_CENTROID unit.

exposure_window.description: Period of exposure the linked values represent.

exposure_window_detail.description: Further detail, e.g. trimester or age range.

exposure_window_years.description: Length of the exposure window in years, e.g. N for N_YEARS_BEFORE_INDEX.

geocoder.description: Geocoding database name and version or release date.

geocoding_mixed_breakdown.description: For MIXED precision, the share of each level, e.g. "80% building, 20% postcode".

intersection_min_overlap_pct.description: Minimum areal overlap, in percent, for INTERSECTION.

kernel_bandwidth_m.description: Kernel bandwidth in metres. Required for KERNEL_DENSITY_WEIGHTED.

kernel_grid_resolution_m.description: Output grid resolution of the kernel density surface, in metres.

network_time_min.description: Network buffer travel time in minutes.

operation.description: GIS operation used to assign values.

participant_coverage_pct.description: Percentage (0-100) of coverage units that received an exposure value.

population_dataset.description: Population dataset used for POPULATION_WEIGHTED centroids.

relinkages.description: Later re-runs of the linkage, e.g. after a geocoder update.

residential_history.description: Extent to which residential moves were accounted for.

residential_history_detail.description: Free-text detail on how residential history was handled.

spatial_linkage_unit.description: Participant location used for the linkage.

study_area_coverage_pct.description: Percentage (0-100) of the study area covered by the source dataset.

role.description: Role in producing the linkage, e.g. senior investigator.

update_frequency.description: For PERIODIC_UPDATE, the update interval as an ISO 8601 duration, e.g. P5Y.

validation_metrics.description: Reported validation metrics. An empty list with validation_reported = false means the dataset was not validated.

validation_reported.description: True if the dataset producers report a validation of the dataset.

admin_unit_approx_population.description: Typical population of one administrative unit.

admin_unit_name.description: For ADMINISTRATIVE_UNIT, the unit type, e.g. LSOA, census tract.

cell_height.description: Grid cell height; metres for GRID_METRIC, degrees for GRID_DEGREE.

cell_width.description: Grid cell width; metres for GRID_METRIC, degrees for GRID_DEGREE.
